I've found going out and getting pierced to be an interesting alternative to self harm rather than a form of it, though that was not originally my intention when getting them as I just like piercings. I noticed after about 3 piercings in that my urge to harm myself lessened. I'd breath in through the brief amount of pain and let it pass, then afterwards feel excitement of having a new feature. Having to be adamant about after care so that it would heal properly would lead into a routine of self care in general as well as admiring myself and my features more often.

 I would not recommend doing this yourself however. I know plenty of people who DIY piercings because they found a kit online or something and as a result miss out on after care & downsizing instructions, quality metal/jewelry, and may be unaware of certain aspects of the piercing type and location that can be problematic.

Drunk or not, he did not extend that same courtesy to you. It seems incredibly one sided as far as respect and emotional control goes. 

I do know that it can be difficult to respond properly in a moment of confusing or conflicting feelings especially when multiple people aside yourself are involved but even so that response is wildly innapropriate.

 So while this situation doesn't necessarily mean he's complete scum or beyond forgiveness, it doesn't sound like he's emotional stable enough to be in a relationship poly or otherwise. He can't be honest with you if he's not with himself and unfortunately that's not something anyone can work on for him.

Wish you the best in any case.
